journeySection.label: Professional Journey
journeySection.heading: From Entrepreneurship to Data & Digital Solutions
journeySection.intro: My professional journey combines entrepreneurship, business operations, customer experience and data analytics. From building and managing a real estate business in Kenya to developing my career in France, each chapter has strengthened my ability to understand problems, improve processes, work with people and turn ideas into practical solutions.

hero.title1: Business Operations | Data Analytics | Digital Solutions
hero.intro: I turn business challenges, data and ideas into practical solutions.
hero.paragraph1: My career combines entrepreneurship and business development in Kenya with professional experience and data-focused development in France.
hero.paragraph2: I bring together business understanding, analytical thinking and technology to improve processes, support better decisions and create practical digital solutions.

highlights.heading: What I Bring
highlights.subheading: A combination of business experience, analytical thinking and digital skills focused on creating practical value.

leadership.title: Business & Operations
leadership.description: Experience in entrepreneurship, business development, customer relations, team coordination and day-to-day operations, with a focus on creating efficient and sustainable processes.

analytics.title: Data & Analytics
analytics.description: Using Power BI, Excel, SQL, Python and data visualisation to explore information, identify patterns and turn data into insights that support better decisions.

digital.title: Digital Solutions
digital.description: Developing modern websites, digital platforms and practical technology solutions that connect business needs with better user experiences and more efficient workflows.

international.title: International Perspective
international.description: Combining entrepreneurial and business experience from Kenya with professional development in France, bringing adaptability, cross-cultural experience and a broad perspective to new challenges.

contact.label: LET'S CONNECT
contact.heading: Let's Build Something Meaningful
contact.paragraph1: Thank you for exploring my professional journey. This portfolio brings together my experience, projects, learning and the solutions I am building as I continue developing at the intersection of business, data and technology.
contact.paragraph2: Whether you are a recruiter, hiring manager, business owner, potential client, collaborator or professional connection, I would be happy to hear from you.
contact.whyDescription: I enjoy understanding how businesses work, identifying opportunities for improvement and using data and technology to turn ideas into practical results. I believe continuous learning and adaptability are essential in a changing digital world.
contact.contactText: I'd love to hear from you. Whether you have a career opportunity, project, collaboration idea, business enquiry or simply want to connect professionally, feel free to send me a message.

finds.title: Lavender Finds
finds.tagline: Every treasure deserves a second story.
finds.paragraph1: I travel across France searching for unique vintage décor, elegant glassware, timeless collectibles and beautiful home accessories.
finds.paragraph2: Every item is carefully selected and photographed before being offered a new home through my curated collection.
finds.paragraph3: Whether you're decorating your home, searching for a unique gift, or collecting beautiful vintage pieces, I hope you'll discover something that inspires you.
